new_candidates.name: target-level evidence contract plus workspace hard completion gate
new_candidates.mechanism: Externalize scientific replication progress into a persistent target matrix. A target can become MATCHED only after a real method implementation exists, the run has recorded provenance, the generated artifact exists, comparison evidence exists, and the report embeds the result; global completion requires all planned targets to be terminal and a deterministic completion validator to pass.

primary_evidence.paper: Coding-agents can replicate scientific machine learning papers
primary_evidence.reported_scope: 12 independent runs across four scientific-ML papers; all 12 workspaces passed the completion gate and all 158 recorded targets were matched with report coverage.
artifact_contract: The repo-local harness, not chat history, is the system of record.
Exactly one target remains ACTIVE while work is incomplete.
A baseline target is registered only after a real paper-method implementation exists under code/config/spec-trace paths.
MATCHED requires generated artifact, provenance, comparison evidence and report embedding.
validate-completion gates the full target set; copied paper outputs and non-method stand-ins are rejected.

new_candidates.interpretation: This is strong implementation/feasibility evidence for method-provenance-aware completion and anti-self-reporting state, and it directly addresses the method-provenance gap identified in the current SAGE frontier. It is not yet matched causal evidence that the gate improves scientific fidelity relative to an otherwise identical no-gate agent.
new_candidates.scope_guard: Do not infer exhaustive coverage of every scientific claim in each source paper from '158 recorded targets': target partition itself varied across repeated runs. Do not infer uniform numerical fidelity merely because a workspace passed completion; the paper reports run-to-run variation in numerical fidelity and acceptance rules.

new_candidates.name: mint-once falsifiable claim contract plus deterministic evidence-recomputation promotion gate
new_candidates.mechanism: Freeze the claim/evidence vocabulary once, link final paper claims to run artifacts, deterministically recompute objective numbers/invariants from recorded results, and block finalization in strict mode when declared evidence is absent, operands are unresolved or stated numbers disagree with the run. Keep subjective semantic overclaim review separate and advisory, then rerun the objective gate after refinement.

observed_implementation_properties: The FINAL claim-evidence hard gate can block finalize_paper in strict mode for numeric mismatch, unresolved operands or missing evidence.
Blocking is deliberately limited to deterministic objective findings; semantic overclaim warnings are advisory because LLM verdicts are non-reproducible.
The metric contract is frozen on first mint because regenerating LLM-derived evidence vocabulary mid-run was observed to hide sibling evidence under changed names.
The gate re-derives reported numbers from recorded results after paper refinement rather than trusting writer text.
primary_evidence.demonstrated_sample: The released CSR-SpMM sample reports 12/12 declared claims with experiment evidence, gate errors 0, five detected overclaims resolved after refine, and correctness max-absolute error 6.79e-6 against an independent dense FP32 reference.

new_candidates.interpretation: This is direct public implementation evidence for a hard promotion block coupled to objective evidence recomputation and a useful design separation between deterministic vetoes and nondeterministic semantic advice. It complements candidate 036 by checking claim integrity after writing rather than only target/provenance completion.
new_candidates.scope_guard: No matched strict-gate versus no-gate scientific-quality ablation was located in this run. The demonstrated result is one autonomous CSR-SpMM study and covers declared claims, not every possible interpretation or omitted claim. Strict blocking is opt-in; the documented default policy is warn/report-only.

adjacent_boundary_evidence.source: The LLM Proposes, the Executive Disposes: A Self-Verifying Agent Instrument that Dissociates Commitment Drift from Binding Drift in Long-Horizon Agents
adjacent_boundary_evidence.observation: The deterministic Executive admits claims only when preregistered predictions match observations and can self-invalidate runs; four of the first eight architecture runs were invalidated by real defects. A commitment-mechanism ablation changed goal abandonment from 0.00 to 1.00 while binding error remained 0.00 under the reported gated cells.
adjacent_boundary_evidence.boundary: Task efficacy was explicitly null: zero level completions across 52 gated ARC-AGI-3 runs. Treat this as structural measurement/claim-admission evidence, not as evidence of scientific problem-solving efficacy.

adjacent_boundary_evidence.source: Refute-or-Promote: An Adversarial Stage-Gated Multi-Agent Review Methodology for High-Precision LLM-Assisted Defect Discovery
adjacent_boundary_evidence.observation: A reported false candidate was unanimously endorsed by ten dedicated reviewers and was killed only by a single empirical test, supporting the distinction between critic consensus and empirical adjudication.
adjacent_boundary_evidence.boundary: This is defect-discovery methodology rather than autonomous science and the authors do not claim autonomous vulnerability discovery; use only as cross-domain boundary evidence for empirical gates.

evidence_refinements: The strongest new implementation evidence splits scientific closure into two independently checkable contracts: method/target provenance before a result can be marked matched (paper-replication harness), and post-writing claim/evidence recomputation before finalization (ARI). This is closer to the current frontier's required composed controller than generic self-review because both make completion a deterministic artifact-state property rather than an LLM assertion.

Both systems still leave a causal gap: neither inspected source supplies a matched experiment isolating hard completion/promotion gating from an otherwise identical agent under equal budget. Keep candidate 027's mandatory review-closure efficacy question open.

ARI's mint-once metric contract supplies concrete evidence for a previously under-specified provenance failure: regenerating LLM-derived evidence vocabulary mid-run can sever exact-match linkage to evidence emitted under earlier names. Stable claim/evidence identifiers should therefore be frozen before adaptive execution and preserved through refine/reconciliation.
negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: Do not equate deterministic completion with scientific truth: a gate only validates the evidence contract it was given and can miss omitted or badly scoped claims.

Do not use subjective LLM reviewer agreement as a hard validity veto when the judgment is non-reproducible; ARI's objective/advisory split is a useful boundary, not proof its semantic reviewer is complete.
Do not treat all-replication-targets-matched as a matched causal improvement over one-shot agents without a controlled comparator.
Do not treat a self-invalidating structural agent as high-performing merely because its internal claims are well gated; the ARC-AGI-3 instrument reports a null efficacy result.
